label: Review this diff
body: Review the diff below for correctness bugs first, then readability. List findings by severity and quote the exact lines.

label: Explain like a reviewer
body: Explain what this code does, what assumptions it makes, and what input would break it.

label: Write the test first
body: Before changing any code, write a test that fails because of this bug. Show me it failing, then fix the code and show it passing.

label: Summarize for a busy reader
body: Summarize the text below in five bullet points for someone with two minutes. Keep every number and name exact.

label: Tighten this paragraph
body: Rewrite the paragraph below to be about half as long without losing any facts. Keep my tone.

label: Plan before acting
body: Do not change anything yet. Read the relevant files, then give me a numbered plan with the risks of each step, and wait for my go-ahead.

label: Report what you verified
body: When you are done, list what you actually ran and observed, separately from what you only expect to work.
